data.one_liner: Get current device language code and locale with full ISO 639-1 and ISO 639-2 dictionaries.
data.what_it_does: Provides current device language codes and localized names (English and native). Allows converting between Locales and ISO language codes, resolving matching variants, and overriding locales during unit testing.
use_when: You need to detect the current device language or locale.
You want a complete catalog of ISO 639-1 and ISO 639-2 codes with native names.
You need robust locale matching and fallback strategies in tests.
avoid_when: You are building a complex multi-language translation and pluralization management system.
You only need standard Flutter Localization without extra language metadata.
strengths: Includes almost all ISO 639 language codes with English and native names.
Provides test-friendly overrides for device language and locale.
Robust fallback and resolution logic for complex locale variants.
weaknesses: Throws a StateError if a lookup fails unless an orElse is specified.
Relies on automatic scrapers which may occasionally require community updates for new language codes.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need comprehensive internationalization, date/number formatting, and message translation support.

alternatives.name: devicelocale
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need raw device locale retrieval without the extensive ISO language database.

data.minimal_example:
final languageCode = LanguageCode.code;
final locale = LanguageCode.locale;
